items.title: Allen Toussaint Interview, 1979-03-13
items.q: I produced it and, well, at that time it was called A&R Man. So I did whatever they do and played, of course, played the piano on it

ctx.x: Dave Bartholomew was with Imperial Records. And those artists that you first worked with on minute included like Lee Dorsey, Jesse Hill, Irma Thomas, Aaron Neville. Yeah. Just hit after hit, great. One classic, song after another. You wrote, did you write Oop Oop Oop Oop Oop?
No, Jesse Hill wrote that. I produced it and, well, at that time it was called A&R Man. So I did whatever they do and played, of course, played the piano on it, but I didn't write it. He wrote that.
And, yeah, yeah, did Lee Dorsey write that or did you write that? Lee Dorsey wrote that himself.
